existing_proofs_preserved: All three public contracts are retained. Full per-program masked load, abs/max/divide, scale cast, int8 conversion, destination scatter and both stores are represented. The machine theorem executes both fp16 and fp32 input routes with real binary16 scale payloads, fp32 arithmetic, independent encoded maximum and signed toward-zero conversion, active outputs and full frame. A padded nonzero-pid witness and undefined-policy independence on InputDefined inputs remain credited. This is not merely an erased Real proof.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: Complete kernel body and both outputs; selected typed formats and defined signed-conversion domain.
Shape checks, next-power-of-two dimensions, tensor strides and full sequence launch are not composed into the public per-program result.

test_harness_classification: The top-level test_* helper only constructs examples and calls production; production does not call it. It remains in the hashed source inventory and is explicitly classified as a harness for this review.
dtype_review: Storage enumerates fp16/fp32 input, while OutScale is fixed fp16, Out is int8 and DestLoc is Nat. The wrapper supplies all four independently without matching dtype guards. Other admitted routes and precise source rejections require coverage; arbitrary dtypes are not assumed to compile.
branch_review: Kernel head/dimension masks and zero padding are covered. Wrapper shape assertions and complete grid remain uncomposed. The public typed value theorem requires each active quotient to admit signed8 conversion, so source zero-scale/nonfinite cases need an explicit coverage decision.

structural_gaps.finding: The wrapper independently accepts K, DestLoc, Out and Out_scale; typed execution only supplies fp16/fp32 K, fp16 scale, int8 output and natural destination metadata.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: The absent source-admitted dtype/index routes or rejection behavior must be represented before numerical bindings can cover them.

numerical_boundary: Native conformance of represented fp16 casts, fp32 division, max and signed conversion may be registered as exact numerical deferrals. Adding dtype paths, host composition and a result or explicit undefined-behavior relation outside InputDefined is structural work. No numerical rule is registered here.
precondition_assessment: Per-program bounds, positive reduction width and injective/nonoverlapping output maps are legitimate selected-domain premises, not defects by themselves. Source-domain exclusions and absent host composition are recorded separately.
